notes.title: White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Complete Edition is out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi all,[/h3] 

Today we are excited to share that [url=https://pqube.co.uk/][b]PQube[/b][/url] continues its longstanding relationship with the [b]White Day[/b] franchise with the launch of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078040/White_Day_2_The_Flower_That_Tells_Lies__Complete_Edition/][b]White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Complete Edition[/b][/url] which brings together the interlocking stories of all previously released episodes and every costume DLC into one definitive package.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484873/78f12015d334b90ee31aab1d978619fa949398d0.jpg[/img]

Some of you may be aware that [b]White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies[/b] originally released episodically, with episodes 2 and 3 functioning as DLC pack add-ons for episode 1. The [b]Complete Edition[/b] replaces this format, so players only need to purchase and download one package into their Steam library for a cleaner experience.    

So what does this mean for existing owners? If you have purchased[b] White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Episode 1[/b] you will now find the [b]Complete Edition[/b] in your library. This means that you will receive the following items [u][b]completely free of charge[/b][/u] as a thank you for your continued support.

[list]
[b][*] White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Episode 2
[*] White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Episode 3
[*] Korean traditional clothes costume - Soo-Jin Jung
[*] Korean traditional clothes costume - Sung-tae Jang
[*] Korean traditional clothes costume - Seo-yeon Kang
[*] Korean traditional clothes costume - Ji-min Yoo
[*] Guard costume - Jin-ho Kim
[*] Guard costume - Hyun-jung Lee
[*] Guard costume - Watchman[/b]
[/list]We hope you’ll enjoy the additional content. 

For new players, here’s a full overview of what you can expect from [b]White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Complete Edition[/b]

[b]WARNING! The following trailer and description contains spoilers for White Day: A Labyrinth Named School![/b]

[previewyoutube=7LAvF1MS8oE;full][/previewyoutube]

On the night of March 14th 2001, exactly one day after the incident at Yeondu High, four individuals return to the school in search of answers to the unsolved mysteries that haunt them. Uncover the dark truth that remained hidden in this direct sequel to the Korean horror cult classic. Investigate bizarre phenomena, evade bloodthirsty killers, and unravel a twisting narrative spread across three unnerving episodes. 

[b]Return to Yeondu High:[/b] Explore the school by torchlight and revisit familiar locations to uncover sinister new revelations, items and areas that had previously remained elusive.

[b]Evade un-killable stalkers:[/b] Monitor your environment to avoid being detected by possessed nightguards and terrifying phantoms. Utilise camera flashes to temporarily stun your pursuers.

[b]Chilling ghost encounters:[/b] Confront twisted manifestations of the building’s tragic past. Discover and document haunted sites with your camera to reveal the disturbing origins of each ghost.

[b]Branching episodes:[/b] Experience the story from multiple perspectives. Learn from your mistakes and revisit completed episodes to reveal alternate routes with 14 possible outcomes.

[b]Solve obscure puzzles:[/b] Search for clues and key items to help solve complex puzzles and escape locked rooms. Decipher hidden riddles to unlock new story paths and additional endings.

[b]Bonus costume DLC included:[/b] Introducing 7 additional costumes including traditional Korean Hanbok for the player characters and a nostalgic janitor tracksuit for the guards!

[h3]EXPOSE THE LIES THAT WERE TOLD...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484873/a34533e5127f3f38d9d91b7582f9b8f6d7bbb1ca.png[/img]

Experience the horrors of Yeondu High School from multiple character's perspectives across three linked episodes, all included in the Complete Edition!
 
[b]Episode 1:[/b] Disturbed by rumours of her involvement in the death of a fellow student, Jung Soo-jin is determined to set the record straight and regain the trust of her crush Jang Sung-tae. But as the pair search for clues, they learn of a far darker secret deep within the bowels of the school, and become prey in a relentless hunt. 
 
[b]Episode 2:[/b] At the same time, former teacher-in-training Kang Seo-yeon arrives to investigate the ambiguous circumstances surrounding her father’s passing on the school grounds. Drawing on her knowledge of the occult, Seo-yeon attempts to reverse an ancient ritual while evading a powerful and malicious ghost that is inexorably drawn to her.
 
[b]Episode 3:[/b] Having made a promise that can’t be broken, 1st year student Yoo Ji-min searches for a way to bring peace to the restless spirit of Han Na-young. Delving deeper into the tragic history of the school and the complex relationships between its students, Ji-min makes a fateful discovery that will lift the veil of obscurity once and for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484873/46543ff98cc8813de2eaaa9cc391656b4987e139.png[/img]

[h3]FATES INTERTWINE[/h3]

[b]Jung Soo-jin:[/b] A recent graduate of Yeondu High, Soo-jin is renowned for her short temper and no-nonsense attitude, which she owes in part to her lonely upbringing in a poor neighbourhood.
 
Before Sung-ah’s tragic death in a fire that engulfed the school’s home economics room, Soo-jin was overheard saying that she would ‘kill Sung-ah’ for telling the teachers about her smoking on school grounds.
 
In the period that followed, many believed Soo-jin to be involved in the incident and so, determined to prove her innocence, Soo-jin invites Sung-tae to sneak into the school…

[b]Jang Sung-tae:[/b] A recent graduate of Yeondu High, Sung-tae mostly keeps to himself, working long, uneventful shifts at a local convenience store. 
 
However, the rumours surrounding Sung-ah’s death left him troubled and he actively avoided contact with Soo-jin thereafter. 
 
Following another fire at the school one year after graduating, Sung-tae suddenly receives an invitation from Soo-jin to return to Yeondu High so that she can set the record straight once and for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29484873/390a8bb210ad00626b77eb8947bea724dea4a8b5.png[/img]

[b]Kang Seo-yeon:[/b] Kang Seo-yeon’s father worked as a Korean language teacher at Yeondu High until one night he inexplicably fell to his death from the roof of the school.
 
Refusing to believe that her father had taken his own life, Seo-yeon transferred to Yeondu high in search of answers. Over the years Seo-yeon developed an affinity with the occult and learned of the many restless souls trapped within the school. 
 
Seo-yeon returns on the night of March 14, 2001 to set into motion her plan to free the spirits and reconcile with the ghosts of her past.

[b]Yoo Ji-min:[/b] A first-year student at Yeondu High who loves to draw, Yoo Ji-min makes a promise to her idol Han So-young that she will solve the mystery of her elder sister’s death and give her the closure she so desperately seeks.
 
Ji-min enters the school on the night of March 14, 2001 in search of Han Na-young’s long forgotten diaries which promise to reveal the circumstances that lead to her untimely demise.

To celebrate the release of [b]White Day 2: The Flower That Tells Lies - Complete Edition[/b]
we’re also offering a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38545/White_Day_Complete_Collection/][u][b]permanent 10% complete the set discount[/b][/u][/url] for all owners of [b]White Day: A Labyrinth Named School.[/b]

Enjoy!

PQube

notes.title: White Day VR: The Courage Test - New Languages Added
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We're please to share that the brand new immersive VR horror experience [i][b]White Day VR: The Courage Test[/b][/i] now supports three new languages!

The game has recently been updated to include [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b],[b] Chinese (Traditional)[/b] and [b]Korean[/b]. English was already supported. 

The update also resolved an issue some users experienced when launching/booting the game. 

Thanks for your support! 

- PQube Team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442650
